identity.title: Make perspective grid ROI teaching coordinate-confident

origin.kind: 2026-08-17 actual Release EXE ten-recipe UX study
origin.summary: Teaching the first Thickness recipe in the perspective Viewer made the screen-to-grid row and column mapping hard to predict and caused one wrong-region attempt.

state.current_summary: Perspective grid teaching hid exact draft coordinates and caused a wrong-region retry. GridRectangle capture now enters the existing Top orthographic fit and shows exact row, column, row count, and column count beside Apply/Cancel. Current Release Wide/Compact, focused regressions, direct operator review, and one-drag reference/measurement target evidence pass without Preview or Run.

claims.text: A novice operator cannot reliably predict the exact grid row and column selected from the perspective Viewer before applying a GridRectangle ROI.

problem.impact: An ROI can be applied to the wrong surface region, forcing rework and potentially producing a plausible but unintended measurement if the operator does not notice the mismatch.

criteria.text: Before Apply, the operator can see the exact candidate row, column, row count, and column count in the current teaching context.
The aid remains readable and bounded in Wide and Compact and does not obscure the taught surfaces or required actions.
Orbit, pan, zoom, picking, ROI adjustment, Enter Apply, Esc Cancel, and the explicit no-execution teaching contract remain intact.
A focused actual-EXE workflow proves correct reference and measurement region selection from an initially non-orthographic camera without corrective redraw.

context.summary: The study records the perspective screen-to-grid ambiguity and preserves the existing explicit Apply boundary.

evidence.observation: While teaching the first dual-surface Thickness recipe in the perspective Viewer, the initial screen-space ROI mapped to the wrong grid region and required correction. Once exact GridRectangle coordinates were known, the same coordinates replayed deterministically across all ten same-size inputs.

evidence.kind: current Release build and focused verification
evidence.observation: The current solution builds Release with 0 warnings and 0 errors. Related verification passes Height Measurement Workbench 56/56, Tool Recipe teaching 50/50, Inspection Workspace selection 64/64, Workbench docking/theme 87/87, Teaching capture ViewModel 25/25, and Shell command-line options 40/40.

evidence.kind: actual Release EXE Wide and Compact UI evidence
evidence.observation: From initially Perspective teaching, Wide English and Compact Korean both enter Top orthographic and show exact row, column, row count, and column count beside Apply/Cancel. Both layouts are readable, bounded, semantically themed, pass screenshot quality on attempt 1, and intersect the dynamically selected leftmost monitor.

evidence.kind: actual Release EXE targeted pointer teaching
evidence.observation: The saved Thickness reference and measurement targets were each retaught from an initially Perspective workflow with one actual drag and no corrective redraw. Candidate target coverage was 0.9756 and 1.0000; exact coordinates were visible, explicit Apply restored both stable routes, and Preview/Run remained unchanged.

evidence.kind: actual Release EXE interaction and lifecycle evidence
evidence.observation: Actual pointer verification passes orbit, pan, wheel zoom, picking/context bindings, Undo, repick, Esc Cancel, a second capture, explicit Apply, ROI move, resize, and display-height adjustment. Authored state remains unchanged until Apply and Preview/Run results remain unchanged throughout teaching.

events.summary: Started the bounded PL-0017 implementation after current Release EXE Wide and Compact reproduction.

Completed coordinate-confident GridRectangle teaching with exact visible draft coordinates, existing Top orthographic entry, current Wide/Compact and one-drag target evidence, and preserved navigation and explicit no-execution contracts.
